description: Java class representing a product image entity with JPA annotations, including fields for image details, relationships, and accessors.

classes.name: ProductImage
classes.description: Entity class for product images, including image metadata, relationships, and transient image data.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the product image filename or path.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the product image filename or path.

methods.name: isDefaultImage
methods.description: Checks if this image is the default image.

methods.name: setDefaultImage
methods.description: Sets whether this image is the default.

methods.name: isImageCrop
methods.description: Checks if the image is cropped.

methods.name: setImageCrop
methods.description: Sets whether the image is cropped.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product with this image.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of image descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of image descriptions.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the transient InputStream of the image.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the transient InputStream of the image.
